note: Masses are catalogue estimates; weigh every part. Prices are indicative USD. Propulsion is a baseline assumption (29 mm certified solid reload), see docs/open-decisions.md.

items.name: Carbon-fibre rods, 6 mm x 500 mm
items.spec: Solid or thick-wall tube, 6 mm dia
items.notes: Cut to 490 mm, deburr, seal ends with CA.

items.name: Stack frames (telemetry, battery 2, PCB, battery 1)
items.notes: Print flat, 4 perimeters, 40% gyroid.

items.name: Landing frame with hinge arms
items.spec: PA-CF recommended: heat from the motor and landing loads

items.name: Landing legs 8 mm x 300 mm + rubber feet
items.spec: Carbon or aluminium tube, hinged at the landing frame
items.notes: 34 deg from vertical, footprint 470 mm

items.name: Leg braces (1.6 mm steel or CF rod)
items.spec: From gimbal mount to leg mid-point

items.name: Gimbal printed parts (mount, outer ring, collar)
items.notes: Keep clear of exhaust: add a heat shield disc (G-06).

items.name: Gear sector 36T + pinion 18T, module 1 (set)
items.spec: Acetal, nylon or printed PA; CAD names gear36t1 / gear36t2
items.notes: 2:1 reduction: servo travel = 2x gimbal travel.

items.name: Digital metal-gear servo, 20 g class, HV
items.notes: Prefer a metal case for heat; buy a spare.

items.name: Pivot pins M3 x 60 + 683ZZ bearings
items.notes: Zero play is a requirement: shim until backlash < 0.3 deg.

items.name: Service-loop cable for servo 2
items.notes: Servo 2 rides on the outer ring.

items.name: Heat shield disc / ablative ring
items.notes: Protects printed parts and wiring near the nozzle.

items.name: Motor tube 29 mm ID, G10 / phenolic, 200 mm
items.notes: Clamped by the gimbal collar; do not glue in.

items.name: 29 mm certified composite reload (consumable)
items.spec: F class first (≈ 25-35 N avg, 20-40 N·s, ≈ 100 g); G class later (60-120 N avg, ≈ 155 g loaded: mass counted here is the G worst case); delay/ejection NOT used
items.notes: Certified motors only (NAR/Tripoli/CAR). Check local law and range rules.

items.name: LiPo 2S 850 mAh, 30C+ (servo pack B)
items.spec: 7.4 V nominal; HV servos run directly from it via fuse
items.notes: Separate pack keeps servo stall current away from the flight computer.

items.name: Fuse / PTC (5 A) + remove-before-flight pin + arm switch
items.spec: RBF pin must be removable with gloves

items.name: Wiring harness, connectors, heat shrink
items.notes: No bare Dupont connectors on a rocket: vibration.

items.name: IMU ICM-42688-P
items.notes: Mount near the stack axis.

items.name: Barometer BMP390
items.notes: Vent the frame; avoid sealed cavities.

items.name: High-g accelerometer ADXL375 (optional)
items.notes: Optional; improves event detection.

items.name: GPS u-blox M10 module
items.notes: Top frame, antenna clear of carbon rods.

items.name: LoRa telemetry module (region band) + whip antenna
items.notes: Check licence and power limits in your country.

items.name: Pyro driver (2 ch, MOSFET + continuity sense)
items.notes: Parachute-release channel + one spare. The motor is lit by the ground ignition controller, never by this board.

items.name: Recovery: parachute 24-36 in + shock cord + release servo (baseline option)
items.notes: Not shown in the 3D model yet.

items.name: Test stand: base, deflector, 20 kg load cell + HX711
items.notes: See docs/phase2-rocket/07-test-stand-procedure.md

items.name: Ignition controller (12 V, continuity check, safety key) + leads
items.notes: Cable length per motor class and range safety distance.

items.name: Fire extinguisher, water, gloves, eye protection
items.notes: Non-negotiable at every firing.
